passage_paraphrase: Party founded 17 October 1972 following DMK split. Party won Dindigul parliamentary by-election in 1973 and Coimbatore Assembly by-election in 1974; supported the 1975–77 Emergency. DMK government dismissed in 1976. First ministry sworn 30 June 1977; second 9 June 1980. In 1979 two AIADMK MPs joined Charan Singh ministry. Congress-DMK won 37/39 Tamil Nadu Lok Sabha seats in January 1980; AIADMK won two; MGR government dismissed, then AIADMK won 129 Assembly seats. Congress alliance won in 1984 despite his hospitalisation. Succession struggle followed death.
